defs.def: the thin pointed end of sth 尖端；尖儿；端

ex.s: She explains we are at a “tipping point” in history and must act now to prevent an extinction-level event for humanity.
ex.t: 她解释说，我们正处于历史上的一个“临界点”，必须立刻行动，以防人类遭遇灭绝级事件。

ex.s: Here are some tips on making wise decisions to minimize pressure on the places we visit and improve our experience.
ex.t: 以下是一些建议，帮助你做出明智的决定，减轻我们游览之地的压力，并提升我们的体验。

ex.s: Tips on Finding a Smart CatB.
ex.t: 寻找聪明猫的小贴士B.

ex.s: So I’ve put together some good tips for starting an art journey.
ex.t: 因此，我整理了一些开始艺术之旅的好技巧。

ex.s: Here are some tips to help improve your reading speed.
ex.t: 这里有一些帮助你提高阅读速度的建议。

ex.s: Here are some tips for talking with your doctor.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 这里有一些与你的医生交谈的建议。

ex.s: So I thought it would be useful to include some humor tips for everyday life.
ex.t: 所以我认为把一些日常生活中的幽默技巧包括进来会有用。

ex.s: Its tip can sense the thickness of objects.
ex.t: 它的鼻尖能感知物体的厚度。

defs.def: a small part that fits on or over the end of sth （装在顶端的）小部件

ex.s: And it was in Chile she discovered she could get last-minute cheap deals on ships going to Antarctica from the islands off Tierra del Fuego, the southernmost tip of the South American mainland.
ex.t: 正是在智利，她发现可以从南美洲大陆最南端的火地岛群岛获得前往南极洲的廉价船票。

ex.s: Here are a few tips to help you win over everyone in the neighborhood quickly
ex.t: 这里有几个小贴士，能帮你迅速赢得邻里所有人的好感。

ex.s: If you want to turn over a new leaf, though, one top tip is that it helps to choose a significant date that signals the start of a new “chapter”.
ex.t: 不过，如果你想重新开始，一个顶级建议是：选择一个象征新“章节”开始的重要日期会很有帮助。

defs.def: a small piece of advice about sth practical 指点；实用的提示

ex.s: Tips on Choosing HouseplantsD.
ex.t: 关于选房的提示 D.

ex.s: Provide tips on repairing their cars.
ex.t: 提供修车建议。

ex.s: Read these tips on hurricane safety so that you and your family can survived this common threat to coastal cities.
ex.t: 阅读这些飓风安全提示，这样你和你的家人就可以在这种对沿海城市的常见威胁中生存下来。

ex.s: Regardless of your past experience, please read these survival tips carefully: • Leave the area quickly but calmly if a wildfire breaks out at any time.
ex.t: 不管你过去的经验如何，请仔细阅读这些生存技巧：• 如果任何时候发生野火，迅速而冷静地离开该区域。

ex.s: Tips for happy and healthy relationships 1 Try to forgive someone when they apologise.
ex.t: 幸福健康的人际关系提示 1 当别人道歉时，试着原谅他们。

defs.def: a secret or expert piece of advice about what the result of a competition, etc. is likely to be, especially about which horse is likely to win a race （尤指有关赛马的）内幕消息，指点
secret information that sb gives, for example to the police, to warn them about an illegal activity that is going to happen 秘密情报；密报；线报
a small amount of extra money that you give to sb, for example sb who serves you in a restaurant 小费；小账

ex.s: Knowing some tips will help ensure that you have an enjoyable meal with friends or family — no matter where you are in the world.
ex.t: 了解一些小贴士将有助于确保你与朋友或家人享用一顿愉快的餐食——无论你在世界的哪个角落。

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在《省钱：美味食物》中，她每周走访一户不同的家庭，并在厨师马特·特巴特的帮助下，提供减少食物浪费的顶级建议，同时准备每天每户不到5英镑的食谱。

ex.s: The tip that comes up most often is simple: build online courses into your weekly schedule, just like what you would do with in-person courses.
ex.t: 最常出现的建议很简单：把在线课程纳入你的每周计划，就像你对其他事情一样。

ex.s: Perhaps these tips will help you make the most of your time.
ex.t: 也许这些建议会帮助你充分利用你的时间。

ex.s: I woke up really early and tip-toed to the kitchen.
ex.t: 我真的很早就醒了，踮着脚走到厨房。

defs.def: a place where you can take rubbish/garbage and leave it 垃圾场；垃圾堆
an untidy place 脏乱的地方
to move so that one end or side is higher than the other; to move sth into this position （使）倾斜，倾倒，翻覆

ex.s: The elephant was found to either use suction at a fixed distance from the pancake to "raise” the object in the air and hold it, or gently press the tip of its trunk against the pancake and apply suction to pick it up.
ex.t: 研究发现，大象要么在离煎饼固定距离处使用吸力把物体抬到空中并吸住，要么轻轻把象鼻尖压在煎饼上施加吸力把它捡起。

defs.def: to make sth/sb come out of a container or its/their position by holding or lifting it/them at an angle 倒出；倾倒；倾覆
to touch sth lightly so that it moves in a particular direction 轻触；轻碰
to leave rubbish/garbage somewhere outdoors in order to get rid of it （在户外）倒垃圾

ex.s: Here are some tips worth following in order to communicate more effectively.
ex.t: 以下是一些值得遵循的、能让你沟通更有效的建议。

defs.def: to give sb an extra amount of money to thank them for sth they have done for you as part of their job 给小费；付小账
to say in advance that sb/sth will be successful 预言 … 获胜；事先说 … 会成功
to cover the end or edge of sth with a colour, a substance, etc. （用颜色、物质等）覆盖 … 的末端，遮盖 … 的边

chunks.cn: 阅读提示尤指西大西洋的）
